# Apply for Service Scope and Data Scope

## **Understand Service Scope and Data Scope**

### **What is Service Scope?**

The Service Scope determines who can use the app

* Who can message the bot
* Who can send/receive messages to/from the bot
* Who can receive the Service Notice
* Who can see the app in the workspace

### **What is Data Scope?**

The Data Scope determines whose data the app can access

* Get/Update/Delete the Employee Profile data
* Get/Update/Delete the Department data
* Get/Update/Delete the Approval Center data

## **Apply Efficiently**

### **How big of a scope should I apply for?**

Please apply for the scope according to your needs. For example, if the target users are the Shopee development team, the Service/Data Scope should not include Garena. Conversely, if the app is designed to serve all Sea employees globally, like a Google Calendar Bot, its Service/Data Scope may include all company members.

### **How do I specify the team I want to apply for?**

In Sea, the organization structure is not public to employees, so please visit HRIS ([https://people.sea.com/](https://people.sea.com/)) to check the team path. If you wish to apply for another team, please let them check for you. Please copy the full team path into the input box, and use ";" to separate multiple departments. Please put "All Employees" in the input box if you wanna open your app for all employees in Sea.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

### **Will the team node cover all employees under it and its sub-nodes?**

Yes. Once you apply for a team node, all employees attached to this team node and other all employees attached to its sub-team node, will be included in the Service/Data Scope.

For example, if you apply for "Singapore > Shopee", all product managers and engineers and business development teams under this team node will be included.

### **How do I check the approval progress?**

The Scope applications will be reviewed by your company's SeaTalk Admin, which will be processed within 12 hours. If you require urgent approval, you can contact [cooper.xuyuan@shopee.com](mailto:cooper.xuyuan@shopee.com). Please ensure that the information provided is complete and accurate to improve efficiency.
